note: Nothing in this file names a person. The fields that identify a contributor or an instrument (Safecast user_id, device_id and record id; Globe at Night SQMSerial, SkyComment and LocationComment) are dropped at fetch time by an allow-list and an assertion, so they never reach this repository. The people, devices, projects and missions in the local dataset are invented by seed_local.
